final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, ma.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY m.link_to_major, ma.department), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / NULLIF(total_count, 0) AS proportion FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2), step4 AS (SELECT department, AVG(proportion) AS avg_proportion FROM step3 GROUP BY department) SELECT s3.major_id, s3.department, s3.member_count, s3.proportion, s3.proportion - s4.avg_proportion AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s3.department = s4.department WHERE s3.proportion > s4.avg_proportion ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
